title: 第4章
slug: 澶墠鍎垮瓙鍤ｅ紶濡堝挭
content_zh: 第一章 酒吧相遇琥珀色的眸子冰冷如刀，微薄的唇斜起一抹嗜血般的浅笑，脸上明明没有任何愤怒，整个人却如同地狱来的修罗！厉目一扫，上一秒还在蠢蠢欲动的记者瞬间安静了下来！叶芊沫完全不明白什么情况，突然间手就被一个温暖的手掌握住，然后拉着她径自离开……这都是什么情况？谁能来给她一拳？她刚刚下飞机就遇到了这么乱糟糟的情况，她的人品，果断已经差到人神共愤的地步了么？看到某个冰冷的男人牵着自己的亲亲妈咪离开的情景，在二楼一直看好戏的小奶娃表示很满意，只是委屈自己那无辜又可怜的妈咪了。接下来的事情该怎么发展呢？小奶娃一张粉嫩的天使脸上笑得无比甜美，好故事才刚刚开始，他才不会就此罢手呢！欧慕瑄拉着叶芊沫离开，记者不敢追，只对着他们的背影一阵狂拍！而记者中，一直提问最多的一个女人收起相机，转脸看向二楼，对着那张粉嫩可爱的天使脸做了一个胜利的手势，然后转身，潇洒的走人！她是伪记者，在本次事件中，起着推波助澜的作用，要问叶芊沫为毛会那么巧的冲向欧慕瑄，吼吼，没错，是她推的，作为杀手，她的力道掌握得刚刚好。圆满完成任务，回去等老大的奖励去！被人牵着走，尤其是一个曾经自己不怎么有好感的男人，叶芊沫极其的反感！他们的过去不过是露水姻缘，就算他记得又能怎么样？现在的叶芊沫有足够的能力不畏惧任何人，任何事！于是，猛然停住脚步，一把甩开那只手，漆黑的眸子释放出来巨大的光芒，让她如同高高在上的女王，高傲，倔强！手心突然一空，欧慕瑄极其不满，回头！她，很美，美得放肆，美得嚣张，美得目空一切！这样强势的女人，抱歉，他没有兴趣！“欧总，谢谢你帮我解围！”叶芊沫抬起头，大胆凝视着他那张精致的妖孽脸！“相互利用而已！”欧慕瑄淡然的回答，声音里除了冰冷，再也没有任何的感情，琥珀色的眸子仿佛不屑去看她。“哦？”叶芊沫轻笑，“不知道欧总利用我了什么？”“明天看完报纸你便会明白。”说完，冷冷地转身，欲走，却又转了回来，嘴角泛起轻蔑的笑意，“星空？”叶芊沫优雅地点点头，“怎么，难道欧总也想聘请我加盟欧氏？”“你，没这个能力！”说完，唇角带着一抹嘲弄，大步离开！什么？！叶芊沫瞬间火大，然而对方已经消失得不见了踪影……靠！六年不见，这个男人还是那么的让人火大！居然小看她？居然说她没这个能力驾驭一个小小的欧氏女装部？开什么玩笑？！叶芊沫被激怒了，而这也是欧慕瑄要达到的效果，这个女人多有才华，他并不关心，他只知道，这次的事件并不是一个偶然，既然有人费心安排，那么他不妨利用一下，先达到自己的目的，回头再找出这个多事的人也不迟！凡是与他作对的人，下场，往往会很惨！第二天，关于星空与欧氏集团总裁欧慕瑄的报道充斥了各大报纸杂志的头版头条，而意外的，竟然全部都是金童玉女，天作之合之类的词汇，完全没有反对声，这么一边倒的新闻绝对是有人在背后操控！一幢幽静的别墅内，叶芊沫揉碎了报纸扔垃圾桶里，转而看向身边的儿子，脸上的笑淡定而扭曲，忍了两天，叶芊沫觉得该是时候跟这个小子算账了！小奶娃腿上放着一部电脑，肉嘟嘟的小手在键盘上挥舞着，头也抬头地说，“叶小姐，淡定，别让冲动的魔鬼控制了你善良的内心。”“我很淡定！”叶芊沫活动着手指的关节，漆黑的眸子微微眯起，“儿子，不打算解释一下么？”小奶娃抬起头，一双琥珀色的大眼睛眨巴着无辜的光芒，“亲亲妈咪，你是在怪我偷偷瞒着你，用你卡里的钱买了这套别墅吗？”哦，对了，这件事，白若芊也是要跟他计较的，儿子没动她的卡，她也没有收到任何的取款提示，但是她卡里的钱确确实实少了，而且也的的确确多了这么一个房子，虽然刚回来就有这么舒适的地方住是好事，但，这更加说明，这小子一早就计划好了要把她骗回来！“小子，你最好把你所有的罪行都给我一一交代清楚，否则……”手指的关节此刻正发出声响，很明显这是揍人的前奏。小奶娃名叫叶逸泽，电脑天才，诡辩专家，腹黑高手，以一张迷倒众生的天使脸伪装着一颗地地道道的恶魔心。“亲亲妈咪，儿子为你选的家，你还满意吗？”转移话题什么的，小奶娃最有经验了，“浅灰色的沙发，白色的地毯，你再看看咱们头顶这个水晶吊灯，有没有很唯美，很梦幻的感觉？”胖嘟嘟的小手指着他们的新家，“我伟大的妈咪，你好了不起啊，年纪轻轻的，就事业有成，给儿子买这么大的房子，儿子好自豪哦！”好吧，被儿子夸，叶芊沫很有成就感，而且，这房子让儿子布置得的确简洁大方，尤其是那串带着水晶流苏的吊灯，那是她的最爱啊！“但是……”算账啊，她是要跟他算账的啊！“还有啊，”小奶娃放下电脑，蹭到叶芊沫的怀里，“亲亲妈咪，你家宝贝趁你睡觉的时候去超市采购了整整一冰箱的你爱吃的哦！”“咳，我是那么容易收买的吗？”“有很多的巧克力，还有你冰淇淋，全是你喜欢的口味哦！”在安抚妈咪方面，谁有他叶逸泽有经验呢？叶芊沫瞬间兴奋了，一扫满心的阴霾，在儿子脸上狠狠地亲了一口，“儿子真孝顺！”“应该的嘛！”小奶娃抱着叶芊沫的脖子，在她怀里蹭啊蹭，“亲亲妈咪是儿子最最爱的人，儿子当然要尽全部的爱来回报啦！”一贯精明强势的妈咪一旦小白起来最有爱了，小奶娃很是喜欢呢！叶芊沫知道自己不是儿子的对手，算了，反正已经回来了，就算被儿子卖了，她也会开开心心帮儿子数钱的，谁让她这么爱他呢？“对了妈咪！”小奶娃从叶芊沫温暖的怀里钻出来，“你不是佳泞阿姨约好了今天见面的吗？”叶芊沫一拍自己的脑袋，立刻站起来，“宝贝，妈咪要出门了，乖乖在家哦！”“放心啦，我会做很多好吃的来孝敬妈咪的！”小奶娃挥动着胖乎乎的小手，看着妈咪远去的背影，琥珀色的眸子里有一抹狡黠一闪而过，亲亲妈咪，儿子这次是真的决定要卖了你哦。听到远去的车声，小奶娃拿起手机，拨通一个电话号码。“佳泞阿姨，我妈咪出发了哦！”“收到，一切按计划进行，事成之后，老规矩，三个吻！”“一个！”小奶外讨价还价，“这件事你才是最大的受益者吧？”“两个，不然我就告发你！”小奶娃的香嫩的吻她最喜欢了，这次立场一定要坚定！“好吧，只许成功，不许失败哦！”小奶娃嘟了嘟自己粉嫩的唇，亲亲妈咪，你看，你伟大的儿子为了成全你的幸福，连自己的美色都牺牲了，你跟爹地……不要辜负我哦！
content_en: Chapter 1 Meeting at the bar. The amber eyes are as cold as knives, and the thin lips tilt into a bloodthirsty smile. There is obviously no anger on the face, but the whole person is like Shura from hell! With a sharp glance, the reporter who was about to move a second ago suddenly fell silent! Ye Qianmo didn't understand what was going on at all. Suddenly her hand was held by a warm palm, and he pulled her away... What is going on? Who can give her a punch? She encountered such a messy situation just after getting off the plane. Has her character and decisiveness deteriorated to the point where people and gods are outraged? Seeing a cold man leading his own mommy away, the little baby boy who had been watching the show on the second floor expressed that he was very satisfied, but he just wronged his innocent and pitiful mommy. How will things develop next? The little baby has a sweet smile on his pink and angelic face. The good story has just begun and he won't stop there! Ou Muxuan pulled Ye Qianmo away. The reporter didn't dare to chase them, but just patted their backs wildly! Among the reporters, the woman who always asked the most questions put away her camera, turned to look at the second floor, made a victory gesture to the pink and lovely angel face, then turned around and walked away in style! She is a fake reporter, and she played a role in fueling this incident. Why did Ye Qianmo rush to Ou Muxuan so coincidentally, roar, yes, it was her who pushed him. As a killer, she has just the right amount of strength. Complete the mission successfully and go back to wait for the reward from the boss! Ye Qianmo was extremely disgusted to be led away by someone, especially a man she didn't like very much in the past! Their past was just a casual marriage, so what if he remembered it? Now Ye Qianmo has enough ability not to be afraid of anyone or anything! Then, she suddenly stopped, threw away the hand, and her dark eyes released a huge light, making her like a high-ranking queen, arrogant and stubborn! Ou Muchuan was extremely dissatisfied when his palms suddenly became empty, so he turned around! She is so beautiful, so beautiful that she is so presumptuous, so beautiful that she is so arrogant, so beautiful that she is so arrogant! Sorry, he is not interested in such a strong woman! "Mr. Ou, thank you for helping me out!" Ye Qianmo raised her head and boldly stared at his exquisite evil face! "It's just mutual use!" Ou Muchuan replied calmly, with no emotion in his voice except coldness, and his amber eyes seemed to disdain to look at her. "Oh?" Ye Qianmo chuckled, "I wonder what Mr. Ou has used me for?" "You will understand after reading the newspaper tomorrow." After saying that, she turned around coldly and was about to leave, but turned back with a contemptuous smile on her lips, "Xingkong?" Ye Qianmo nodded gracefully, "Why, does Mr. Ou also want to hire me to join Ou?" "You don't have the ability!" After saying that, with a touch of ridicule on his lips, he strode away! What? ! Ye Qianmo was instantly furious, but the other party had disappeared without a trace... Damn it! After six years of not seeing each other, this man is still so infuriating! Actually underestimate her? She actually said that she didn't have the ability to control a small Ou's women's clothing department? Are you kidding me? ! Ye Qianmo was irritated, and this was what Ou Muxuan wanted to achieve. He didn't care how talented this woman was. He only knew that this incident was not an accident. Since someone took the trouble to arrange it, he might as well take advantage of it to achieve his own goal first, and it would not be too late to find this troublesome person later! Anyone who goes against him will often end up miserable! The next day, reports about Xingkong and Ou Muxuan, the president of Ouji Group, filled the front pages of major newspapers and magazines. Surprisingly, all of them were about golden boy and beautiful girl, a match made in heaven. There was no objection at all. Such one-sided news was definitely controlled by someone behind the scenes! In a quiet villa, Ye Qianmo crushed up the newspaper and threw it into the trash can. She then turned to look at her son beside her. The smile on her face was calm and twisted. After enduring it for two days, Ye Qianmo felt that it was time to settle the score with this boy! There was a computer on the little baby's lap. Her chubby little hands were waving on the keyboard. She raised her head and said, "Miss Ye, calm down. Don't let the impulsive devil control your kind heart." "I'm very calm!" Ye Qianmo He moved his finger joints and narrowed his dark eyes slightly, "Son, aren't you going to explain?" The little baby raised his head, his big amber eyes blinking innocently, "Kiss Mommy, are you blaming me?" Did he secretly hide it from you and use the money in your card to buy this villa? "Oh, by the way, Bai Ruoqian also wanted to argue with him about this matter. Her son didn't touch her card, and she didn't receive any withdrawal reminder, but the money in her card was indeed less, and there was indeed such an extra house. Although it was a good thing to have such a comfortable place to live when she came back, this further showed that this guy had planned to trick her back! "Boy, you'd better explain all your crimes to me one by one, otherwise..." The joints of his fingers were making noise at this moment, which was obviously a prelude to beating someone. The little baby's name is Ye Yize. He is a computer genius, sophistry expert, and master of evil. He has an angelic face that fascinates all living beings and disguises an out-and-out devil's heart. "Dear Mommy, are you satisfied with the home your son has chosen for you?" The little baby was the most experienced in changing the subject, "The light gray sofa, the white carpet, and look at the crystal chandelier above our heads. Doesn't it feel very beautiful and dreamy?" The chubby little finger pointed at their new home, "I am great. "Mommy, you are so amazing. You are so young and have a successful career. You are so proud to buy such a big house for your son!" Well, Ye Qianmo felt very accomplished after being praised by her son. Moreover, the house was really simple and elegant for her son to decorate, especially the chandelier with crystal tassels, which was her favorite.
